problem: Random physical offsets repeatedly read the same primitive state words through JNI
candidate: Snapshot entire small state planes into call-local C int[8][256]
complexity_and_space: O(stages*capacity + rows*stages) C ops; 8KiB bounded stack without unconditional clearing, O(stages) whole-plane region reads
donor_or_reference: M3JDK21 existing stage-cache and bulk index selector
verification_and_rationale: Only when 1-8 stages each <=256 slots and logical count>=512; preserve all physical bounds, masks and references

problem: Large state planes impose expensive eager copying
candidate: Keep original JNI per-slot checked region fetch
complexity_and_space: O(rows*stages) JNI region reads, constant scratch
verification_and_rationale: Any stage length>256 retains original logic and Java/JNI ABI

problem: Native snapshot setup may cost more than work
candidate: Keep per-slot existing implementation for count<512
complexity_and_space: O(rows*stages) native state reads, no prefetch
verification_and_rationale: Threshold is conservative and unbenchmarked on ARM64; verify PSS/RSS and mobile energy

problem: Per-call stage references grow with unbounded plane count
candidate: Retain original stage-by-stage lookup beyond eight stages
verification_and_rationale: No changes to 9+ stage selection, even when capacities are small

problem: Avoid pinning/retaining movable primitive Java arrays
candidate: Use bounded GetIntArrayRegion copies into native-owned call-local arrays
complexity_and_space: O(stages*capacity) copy, no persistent JVM pointer
verification_and_rationale: ART has native region-copy primitives; architectural inspiration only

problem: Avoid object-per-entry state on constrained devices
candidate: Use existing parent-owned row indexes, physical offsets and mask vectors
complexity_and_space: O(rows + physical slots) M3 representation, no entry objects
verification_and_rationale: DEX storage encoding is not Java object semantics; no DEX execution integration claimed

problem: Select required and forbidden full-width object-state flags
candidate: Keep existing state & required == required and state & forbidden == 0
verification_and_rationale: Retain signed sign-bit and 32-bit masks, no byte truncation

problem: Evaluate required/excluded state masks without allocating Boolean objects
verification_and_rationale: No additional branchless rewrite without benchmark evidence

problem: LeetCode two-pointer removal edits the source array
verification_and_rationale: REJECT: M3 selection returns detached exact-length array preserving source ownership

problem: Compressed selection masks might reduce native and Java retained memory
verification_and_rationale: DEFER: no population/density evidence to justify change to current 32-bit state plane

problem: Sorted backed Set/NavigableMap predicates are observable Java callbacks
complexity_and_space: Not equivalent to detached pure-state filter
verification_and_rationale: KEEP separate from this native state-plane atom; PR #1659 handles stored representatives

problem: Native batching must beat JNI crossing, copy, stack and GC costs
candidate: Compare on ARM64 ART and matched JDK builds (cold/warm CPU,PSS,RSS,energy)
